## LoggerFunction type

Type of the function that writes a message.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type LoggerFunction = (message: string) => void;
```

## Remarks

It is passed to the `write()` method, which subclasses may override: it writes the message on the console, on the standard output or on the standard error.
